text:
elaine (OpenModelX): Hey y'all, OpenModelX is ready to list Citrine-7B on Redwood marketplace. Questions on redistribution language, export controls, and offering a HWCo-optimized bundle.

mike (partnerships): Nice! Top items: confirm license text for weights, provenance record, export-control self-attestation, and how the HW bundle is structured (driver redistrib, support SOW).

ana (legal): Hi — need the exact license file and any extra clauses OpenModelX added (you mentioned an export restriction paragraph). Also we require a short provenance statement: where weights were trained, third-party data usage, and any restricted datasets.

elaine (OpenModelX): I'll upload license + provenance doc to the partner portal in a few. The license is MIT-ish for code, weights distributed under a permissive grant but with one export-control clause.

shay (product): Marketplace SKU plan: two SKUs — "citrine-7b" (hosted) and "citrine-7b-hwco-bundle" (dedicated + HWCo). The bundle page should include supported instance types, tested quantization profile, and a tested-config block. Keep benchmarks non-comparative.

mike (partnerships): For revenue share, HWCo usually asks for an uplift on hw bundles. Jordan?

jordan (HWCo): We can do 10-15% uplift on bundle MSRP. Need to clarify: we don't permit redistribution of modified driver binaries without a signed SOW. Also require a compatibility statement that lists supported kernel/driver versions.

ana (legal): Drafting redistribution clause now: will require partner attestation of origin, allow Redwood to redistribute drivers under an SOW, include export control text, and cap indemnity for customer use. Will post redline by EOD.

mike (partnerships): Timeline: legal redline EOD, SKU pages + assets by Wed, announcement draft by Fri. Target launch two weeks after sign-off to align marketing + HWCo channels.

elaine (OpenModelX): Fine with timeline. Can we include a short inference benchmark on the bundle listing?

shay (product): Yes — include a "tested config" section with exact hardware, batch size, and quantization. Example note: "results obtained on HWCo A100-v2, int8 quantization, batch=1; actual latency may vary."

ops-bot: reminder: run export-control script before uploading: `./scripts/check_export_controls.sh citrine-7b`

ana (legal): Also: announcement copy must avoid implying Redwood endorses training data sources. Use language: "partner-provided model; see partner license and provenance."

mike (partnerships): Elaine — confirm embargo and PR channels. Also need partner PR contact and logos.

elaine (OpenModelX): Prefer coordinated blog + HWCo co-post + marketplace spotlight. Embargo request: June 10, assets due by June 7. PR contact: press@openmodelx.ai. Logos uploaded to portal.

jordan (HWCo): Will confirm uplift and SOW text by tomorrow AM.

mike (partnerships): Action items: Ana -> redline (EOD). Shay -> SKU templates + benchmark template (Wed). Jordan -> confirm uplift & driver redistribution constraints (Tom). Elaine -> license + provenance + PR contact. I'll sync with marketing once legal clears. :thumbsup:

elaine (OpenModelX): Thanks — uploading docs now.

mike (partnerships): Filed checklist at /shared/partnerships/citrine-7b-onboard/checklist.md

ops-bot: checklist created: /shared/partnerships/citrine-7b-onboard/checklist.md
